newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers little changed, discussions thin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers little changed, discussions thin.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices on Tuesday were little changed from Monday as most traders were away for an oil industry conference, brokers said.
"It is a very quiet market", one trader said.

Majors and independents were quoting 180-cst at $121-$125 and 380 cst at $117-$120. Indications were very wide-ranged, traders said. Prices in Fujairah and South Korea are very competitive, causing some shipowners to cover their requirements there, they said.
MDO and gas oil were steady at $200-$205 and $215-$216 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082).
